scripts.build: npm run build -w @pindash/contracts && npm run build -w @pindash/database && npm run build -w @pindash/api && npm run build -w @pindash/worker && npm run build -w @pindash/web
scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -n web,api,worker -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @pindash/web" "npm run dev -w @pindash/api" "npm run dev -w @pindash/worker"
scripts.dev:infra: docker compose up -d postgres redis minio minio-init
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @pindash/contracts && npm run build -w @pindash/database && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
